summary: Maze Therapeutics filed an 8-K disclosing an underwritten public offering of 5,540,000 common shares at $23.50/share and pre-funded warrants for 850,000 shares at $23.499 each, raising ~$144.7M net proceeds. Leerink Partners acted as sole underwriter. The offering was made under an existing automatic shelf registration statement (Form S-3). Proceeds will fund R&D for MZE829 (APOL1-mediated kidney disease) and MZE782 (PKU and CKD) and general corporate purposes, extending the cash runway into 2029. This is a routine secondary equity issuance, not a special situation.
